description: Predeclared FFT validation suites consumed by scripts/run_test_profile.py; unsupported research targets are never treated as runnable.

hardware.note: Recompute core-count boundaries and legal envelopes from the local hardware profile on another SoC.

current.description: Historical 49-point published C2C grid; retain unchanged for comparison.
requirements: All correctness trials must pass; retain historical snapshot separately.

smoke.description: Fast supported-envelope checks including odd batch and the 48-AIV boundary.
requirements: Real and numerical-pattern cases must not be silently skipped.
Check every batch row for small smoke cases.
Reject zero/non-power-of-two lengths, zero batch, null pointers, and offset overflow.

regression.description: Nightly correctness and mapping-breakpoint coverage on the current supported envelope.
requirements: Verify R2C/C2R round-trip, DC/Nyquist values and conjugate symmetry.
Verify repeated Plan reuse, shape changes, create/destroy and error handling.
Record maximum error across all trials, not the best error.

publication.description: Predeclared performance matrix: retain the historical grid and add hardware boundaries and equal-total-point comparisons.
requirements: Predeclare the grid before sampling; publish all failures and losing points.
Compare the same precision, direction, normalization, placement and timing scope.
Retain raw trials and report median, spread, correctness and selected mapping.
Separate device-only, host end-to-end, Plan setup and first-use timings.
Model calibration and held-out validation workloads must be disjoint.
Fixed-total-point shapes use batch=total_points/n and are deduplicated with the Cartesian grid.

stress.description: Memory-aware soak and lifecycle tests executed by the dedicated budgeted runner (scripts/run_stress.py).
requirements: Budget host, device, output, workspace and reference memory before allocation.
Reserve free-memory headroom; do not allocate an offset-limit shape blindly.
Check leaks, repeated execution, timeout and recoverable allocation failure.
Future async/concurrent tests must wait for a device-pointer/stream contract.

future-long-fft.description: Research acceptance targets only; the segmented long backend covers forward C2C 8192..65536 in fft_check pending the evidence campaign, larger lengths and 2D remain unsupported.
requirements: Implement segmented or multi-AIV FFT with explicit boundary dependencies and workspace.
Include boundary reorder/transpose, GM traffic, synchronization and workspace in measurements.
Do not treat zero-padding to a power of two as the original-length DFT.

future_work.acceptance: Execute all required patterns and seeds with all-trial correctness gates.
R2C n=8192 and R2C/C2R round-trip gates pass on hardware; current-protocol rows with per-row correctness are published in the snapshot with a win/tie/loss heatmap.
Memory-budgeted soak and lifecycle report without unbounded allocations.
Long-length correctness and same-total-point throughput matrix with complete boundary costs.
Rectangular 2D and non-contiguous contracts including transpose and gather/scatter costs.
Public inverse C2C, normalization and each precision have independent numerical gates.
